subject: Shiny App Freezing in Chrome, but not safari

messages.author: 46056b8d21e16885
messages.subject: Shiny App Freezing in Chrome, but not safari
parts:
Hello,

I've built a ShinyApp (built via shinydashboard and hosted on an internal shiny server at my company; not on shinyapps.io). It's worked perfectly fine for over a month, but, as of today, is freezing on Google Chrome. It continues to work fine in Safari. Any thoughts on why this could be? My early guess is that Chrome is shutting down because it's asked to load what it considers to be too much data from the server, but I don't know if that's indeed the case.

And, fwiw, I've tried to use chrome's developer console to find something informative, but the page freezes before any insightful info can be displayed that way. 

Also, I know it's best practice to try to create a reproducible example, but don't know how to do so in this case since it'd be tough to recreate this exact bug without my exact code (which is unfortunately got some proprietary data in it that I can't share). 

PS - I've also posted this question on Stackoverflow if you'd rather answer it there: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/37739186/what-could-cause-a-shiny-app-to-freeze-in-chrome-but-not-in-safari.

Thanks in advance for any ideas!

-Lucas

Some supporting evidence for this theory: my app is running as expected in Chrome Canary Version 54.0.2788.0 canary (64-bit), but is not working in Chrome Version 51.0.2704.106 (64-bit)
